title: ononis spinosa subsp. australis
intro: Ononis spinosa subsp. australis, commonly known as Australian jointed spiny restharrow, is a plant species in the legume family. It is a shrub-like perennial with thorny stems and compound leaves, native to Australia and New Zealand. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Ononis spinosa subsp. australis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
